name: Bank Fixed Deposit (Scheduled Commercial Bank)
structure: Term Deposit with Scheduled Bank
economicExposure: Bank Balance Sheet & RBI Liquidity Facility
returnVariability: Zero (contractual guaranteed interest)
maxDrawdown: 0.0% (Principal protected up to ₹5 Lakh by DICGC)
creditRisk: Extremely Low (DICGC insured up to ₹5L per depositor per bank)
marketRisk: None (if held to maturity)
liquidity: High (Premature withdrawal available with 0.5%–1% penalty)
fees: Zero upfront; 0.5%–1.0% penalty on premature break
taxOnIncome: Taxed at marginal slab rate under Income from Other Sources
tdsDetails: 10% TDS under Section 194A if interest > ₹40,000 (₹50,000 for Senior Citizens)
regulatoryFramework: RBI Banking Regulation Act, 1949 & DICGC Act, 1961
investorEligibility: All Indian Residents, Minors, HUFs, NRIs (NRO/NRE)
permanentLossRisk: Near Zero for Scheduled Commercial Banks
exitRestrictions: Immediate redemption online or at branch
suitabilityHorizon: 6 months to 3 years (Emergency reserves & near-term goals)

name: Small Finance Bank Fixed Deposit
structure: Term Deposit with RBI-Licensed Small Finance Bank
economicExposure: Priority Sector & MSME Lending Balance Sheet
returnVariability: Zero (contractual fixed interest)
creditRisk: Low to Moderate (SFB credit books carry higher MSME concentration, but covered by DICGC)
marketRisk: None (held to maturity)
liquidity: Moderate to High (Premature penalty 1%)
fees: Zero upfront; 1% premature penalty
taxOnIncome: Taxed at marginal slab rate under Section 56(2)
tdsDetails: 10% TDS under Section 194A if interest > ₹40,000
regulatoryFramework: RBI Small Finance Bank Operating Guidelines & DICGC
investorEligibility: Indian Residents, Senior Citizens, HUFs
diversification: Moderate if allocated across multiple SFBs up to ₹5L each
permanentLossRisk: Low (RBI prompt corrective action safeguards depositors)
exitRestrictions: Online redemption available

name: Government of India Treasury Bills (T-Bills)
structure: Zero-Coupon Sovereign Debt Instrument (91, 182, 364 days)
economicExposure: Sovereign Obligation of the Republic of India
returnVariability: Minimal
creditRisk: Zero (Sovereign Guarantee)
marketRisk: Very Low (very short duration)
liquidity: High via RBI Retail Direct or NSE/BSE debt market
fees: Zero commission via RBI Retail Direct
taxOnIncome: Discount at issue vs face value is taxed as STCG at slab rate
tdsDetails: No TDS deducted on Government Securities
regulatoryFramework: RBI Government Securities Act, 2006
investorEligibility: All Indian Residents via RBI Retail Direct / Demat
permanentLossRisk: Absolute Zero in INR terms
exitRestrictions: Tradable in secondary market via NDS-OM

name: Arbitrage Mutual Funds
structure: Open-Ended Mutual Fund Scheme (Simultaneous Cash & Futures trades)
economicExposure: Cash-Futures spread on NSE/BSE (Market-neutral)
returnVariability: Very Low (fluctuates with prevailing derivative roll spreads)
maxDrawdown: -0.2% to -0.5% (rare short-term negative daily roll yields)
creditRisk: Extremely Low (Counterparty is Clearing Corporation of India)
marketRisk: Near Zero (fully hedged long stock vs short future)
liquidity: Very High (T+1 business day redemption)
lockIn: None (Exit load 0.25% if redeemed within 15–30 days)
fees: Expense ratio: 0.15% – 0.40% (Direct Plan)
taxOnIncome: Treated as Equity Mutual Fund for taxation purposes!
tdsDetails: No TDS on capital gains for resident investors
regulatoryFramework: SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations, 1996
investorEligibility: All Indian Residents, HUFs, Corporates, NRIs
transparency: High (Daily NAV and full monthly portfolio disclosure)
permanentLossRisk: Extremely Low
exitRestrictions: Redeemable anytime
suitabilityHorizon: 3 months to 2 years (Superior post-tax yield vs FDs for 30% slab)

name: Nifty 50 Index Fund / Large-Cap ETF
structure: Passive Open-Ended Index Scheme / ETF
economicExposure: Top 50 Indian Corporations by Free-Float Market Cap
returnVariability: High (Annual standard deviation ~14% to 18%)
creditRisk: None (Equity ownership)
marketRisk: High (Macroeconomic, inflation, geopolitical and cyclical market risk)
liquidity: Very High (T+1 rolling settlement)
fees: Expense ratio: 0.05% – 0.20% (Direct Plan / ETF)
taxOnIncome: Dividends taxed at slab; 10% TDS under 194K if > ₹5,000
tdsDetails: No TDS on capital gains for resident individuals
regulatoryFramework: SEBI & NSE Index Methodology Guidelines
investorEligibility: All Retail Investors, NRIs, FPIs
permanentLossRisk: Near Zero for the broad Indian economy index over 10+ years
exitRestrictions: Instantly tradable on exchange or redeemable with AMC

name: Nifty Midcap 150 Index / Active Mid-Cap Fund
structure: Active or Passive Equity Scheme
economicExposure: Companies ranked 101st to 250th by Market Capitalisation
returnVariability: Very High (Annual standard deviation ~18% to 22%)
creditRisk: None
marketRisk: Very High (Prolonged multi-year cyclical underperformance cycles)
liquidity: High
fees: Passive: 0.25%–0.40%; Active: 0.70%–1.10% (Direct)
taxOnIncome: Dividends at slab rate
tdsDetails: No TDS on capital gains for residents
regulatoryFramework: SEBI Categorisation & Rationalisation Circulars
investorEligibility: All Retail Investors
diversification: Good across mid-tier industrial and consumer leaders
permanentLossRisk: Low for index; Moderate for concentrated single stock bets
exitRestrictions: Open-ended redemption

name: Nifty Smallcap 250 / Active Small-Cap Fund
structure: Active or Passive Equity Scheme
economicExposure: Companies ranked 251st to 500th by Market Capitalisation
returnVariability: Extreme (Annual standard deviation >22%)
creditRisk: None
marketRisk: Extreme (Severe liquidity dry-ups during bear phases)
liquidity: Moderate to High via Mutual Funds (Fund may restrict lump-sums)
fees: Direct plan TER: 0.60% – 1.05%
taxOnIncome: Dividends at slab rate
tdsDetails: No TDS on capital gains
regulatoryFramework: SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations
investorEligibility: Experienced Retail Investors with High Risk Capacity
permanentLossRisk: High for individual micro-caps; Low to Moderate for broad index
exitRestrictions: AMC may restrict lump sum inflows during euphoric valuations

name: Nifty 200 Momentum 30 Index Fund
structure: Smart-Beta Quantitative Factor Index Fund / ETF
economicExposure: Top 30 stocks with highest 6-month & 12-month risk-adjusted price momentum
returnVariability: Very High (Sharp factor rotations & momentum crashes)
creditRisk: None
marketRisk: Very High (Prone to severe drawdowns when market leadership flips)
liquidity: High
fees: Expense ratio: 0.35% – 0.50% (Direct Plan)
taxOnIncome: Dividends at slab
tdsDetails: No TDS on gains
regulatoryFramework: SEBI Rules for Factor-Based Indices
investorEligibility: High-Conviction Equity Investors
diversification: Moderate (Concentrated in 30 trending stocks with 5% stock cap)
permanentLossRisk: Low for index; High tactical volatility
exitRestrictions: Open-ended

name: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB)
structure: Government Security Denominated in Grams of 999 Gold
economicExposure: London Bullion Market Association (LBMA) Gold Price in INR
returnVariability: Moderate to High
creditRisk: Zero (Direct sovereign obligation of the Government of India)
marketRisk: Medium (Gold price volatility in USD and INR exchange rate)
liquidity: Moderate (Listed on NSE/BSE; trading volume can have price discounts)
lockIn: 8 years (RBI early redemption window opens after Year 5)
fees: Zero storage fee; Zero making charges; Zero asset management fee
taxOnIncome: 2.50% annual coupon paid semi-annually is taxed at slab rate
taxOnGains: 100% TAX-FREE at redemption with RBI under Section 47(viic)!
tdsDetails: No TDS deducted on coupon or redemption
regulatoryFramework: RBI Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme & Ministry of Finance
investorEligibility: Indian Residents, HUFs, Trusts, Charitable Institutions
diversification: Superb portfolio non-correlation hedge against equity panics
permanentLossRisk: Zero default risk; Subject only to market price of gold
exitRestrictions: Secondary exchange sale or RBI redemption at 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th year
suitabilityHorizon: 5 to 8 years (The ultimate gold investment vehicle in India)

name: Gold ETF / Gold Mutual Fund
structure: Exchange-Traded Fund backed 100% by 995+ Physical Gold Bullion
economicExposure: Domestic Physical Spot Gold Price
returnVariability: Moderate
creditRisk: Very Low (Physical gold vaulted with SEBI-approved custodians)
marketRisk: Moderate
liquidity: Very High (Real-time exchange trading or AMC creation units)
fees: TER: 0.15% – 0.50% annually
taxOnIncome: No dividend distributed
taxOnGains: LTCG: 12.5% without indexation if held > 24m (Finance Act 2024)
tdsDetails: No TDS on capital gains
regulatoryFramework: SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations (Gold ETF Scheme)
investorEligibility: All Investors with Demat Account
permanentLossRisk: Near Zero
exitRestrictions: Instantly tradable on NSE/BSE

name: Long-Term Government Securities (10-Year G-Sec)
structure: Dated Sovereign Bond issued by RBI on behalf of GoI
economicExposure: Indian Sovereign Debt Benchmark (10Y Yield)
returnVariability: Low to Moderate (Price moves inversely to bond yield changes)
maxDrawdown: -8% to -12% (During sharp RBI rate-hiking cycles due to duration)
creditRisk: Zero Sovereign Default Risk
marketRisk: Moderate (Modified duration ~6.8 means 1% yield rise drops price ~6.8%)
liquidity: High in institutional market; Moderate in retail NDS-OM
fees: Zero brokerage via RBI Retail Direct
taxOnIncome: Semi-annual coupon taxed at investor slab rate
taxOnGains: LTCG: 12.5% without indexation if held > 12m (Finance Act 2024)
tdsDetails: Zero TDS on Government Securities
regulatoryFramework: RBI & Public Debt Act
investorEligibility: All Indian Residents
permanentLossRisk: Zero if held to maturity; Mark-to-market risk if sold early
exitRestrictions: Tradable on RBI Retail Direct NDS-OM

name: Listed AAA-Rated Corporate Bonds / PSU Bonds
structure: Senior Secured/Unsecured Non-Convertible Debentures (NCD)
economicExposure: Top-Tier Public & Private Corporations (REC, PFC, HDFC, NABARD)
returnVariability: Low
creditRisk: Very Low for AAA PSU; Low for Top Private AAA
marketRisk: Moderate (Interest rate duration risk)
liquidity: Moderate (via SEBI-regulated Online Bond Platforms / RFQ)
minInvestment: ₹10,000 (SEBI reduced face value from ₹1 Lakh to ₹10k in 2024)
fees: Zero to platform mark-up (typically built into quoted YTM)
taxOnIncome: Coupon taxed at investor marginal slab rate
tdsDetails: 10% TDS under Section 193 (Exemption for listed demat bonds was removed in 2023)
regulatoryFramework: SEBI NCS (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) Regulations
investorEligibility: Retail Investors, Corporates, Family Offices
transparency: High (Audited financial statements and rating rationales)
permanentLossRisk: Low for AAA rated entities
exitRestrictions: Tradable via OBPP platforms or exchange secondary window

name: P2P Lending Diversified Portfolio
structure: Direct Peer-to-Peer Unsecured Borrower Promissory Notes via NBFC-P2P
economicExposure: Unsecured Retail Consumer Loans (Sub-prime & Near-prime)
returnVariability: High (Heavy sensitivity to macroeconomic credit cycles)
creditRisk: Extreme (Unsecured borrowers with low CIBIL scores)
marketRisk: Low to equity markets, but high systemic credit risk
liquidity: Zero secondary liquidity (Capital locked for loan tenures 6–36m)
minInvestment: ₹10,000 (RBI caps aggregate exposure at ₹50 Lakhs across all platforms)
fees: Platform management fee: 1.0% – 2.0% of deployed capital
taxOnIncome: Interest taxed at full marginal slab rate (up to 31.2% / 39%)
taxOnGains: No capital gains; Bad debt loss CANNOT be set off against interest income!
tdsDetails: Platforms do not deduct TDS; Investor must report in ITR
regulatoryFramework: RBI Master Directions - NBFC P2P Lending Platform 2017 & 2024 Guidelines
investorEligibility: Indian Residents with CA Certificate if investing > ₹10 Lakhs
transparency: Low to Moderate (Platform black-box algorithms and delayed NPA disclosures)
diversification: Must diversify across minimum 500+ borrowers to avoid single-default ruin
permanentLossRisk: Very High on individual defaulted loans (Recovery rates typically 15–25%)
exitRestrictions: Cannot prematurely withdraw until loans amortise
operationalEffort: Moderate (reinvestment management to avoid idle cash drag)
suitabilityHorizon: 1 to 2 years (Strictly for high-risk speculative satellite capital)

name: Indian Commercial Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs)
structure: SEBI-Regulated Business Trust holding Grade-A Commercial IT Parks & Offices
economicExposure: Top-tier MNC Office Leases in Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Hyderabad, Pune
returnVariability: Moderate (Traded on stock exchange like listed equities)
creditRisk: Low (Top-tier global Fortune 500 tech tenants with long lock-in leases)
marketRisk: Moderate (Interest rate cycles and office occupancy rates)
liquidity: High (Listed on NSE/BSE with daily liquidity)
fees: Investment Manager Management fee: ~1% of Net Asset Value
taxOnIncome: Bifurcated: Interest (slab), Dividend (tax-free or slab), Repayment of Debt (Sec 56(2)(xii))
tdsDetails: 10% TDS on taxable distribution components
regulatoryFramework: SEBI (Real Estate Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014
investorEligibility: All Retail & Institutional Investors
transparency: Very High (Quarterly earnings calls, independent valuations, asset disclosures)
diversification: High across dozens of premium commercial office assets
permanentLossRisk: Low for blue-chip Grade A REITs
exitRestrictions: Instantly sellable on NSE/BSE during market hours
operationalEffort: Passive (Distributions deposited directly into bank quarterly)
suitabilityHorizon: 5+ to 10 years (Ideal for inflation-hedged regular quarterly income)

name: Direct Residential Rental Property
structure: Direct Physical Immovable Property Ownership
economicExposure: Local Indian Urban Real Estate Micro-Market
returnVariability: Low quoted volatility (illiquidity conceals mark-to-market fluctuations)
creditRisk: Moderate (Tenant default, delayed rent, eviction litigation)
marketRisk: High (Micro-market infrastructure delays, unsold inventory overhang)
liquidity: Extremely Low (Takes 6 to 18+ months to find a buyer and complete registration)
fees: Stamp duty & registration: 5%–8%; Brokerage: 1%–2%; Property maintenance
taxOnIncome: Rental income taxed under House Property with 30% statutory deduction
taxOnGains: LTCG: 12.5% without indexation (or 20% with indexation if acquired pre-July 2024)
tdsDetails: Tenant must deduct 5% TDS under 194-IB if monthly rent > ₹50,000
regulatoryFramework: State RERA Acts, Transfer of Property Act, Municipal Tenancy Laws
investorEligibility: Indian Residents, NRIs, OCIs
complexity: Very High (Legal due diligence, title verification, physical upkeep)
transparency: Very Low (Opaque micro-market pricing and unrecorded cash components)
diversification: Catastrophically concentrated (single physical location and single building)
permanentLossRisk: Moderate (Title litigation, builder bankruptcy before possession, structural decay)
exitRestrictions: Severe illiquidity and high transfer friction
operationalEffort: High (Tenant vetting, maintenance, property tax payments, society disputes)

name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
structure: Central Government Statutory Small Savings Scheme
economicExposure: Government of India Consolidated Fund
returnVariability: Zero (fixed quarterly sovereign rate)
creditRisk: Zero (Backed by Sovereign Parliament Act)
marketRisk: None
liquidity: Very Low (Partial withdrawal permitted only after 7 years)
fees: Zero
taxOnIncome: 100% TAX FREE under Section 10(11)
tdsDetails: Zero TDS
regulatoryFramework: Public Provident Fund Act, 1968 & Government Savings Promotion Act
investorEligibility: Indian Resident Individuals (One account per citizen; No NRI fresh opens)
permanentLossRisk: Absolute Zero (Cannot be attached by court decree for debt)
exitRestrictions: Full closure only after 15 years; Premature closure allowed only for life-threatening medical/higher education with 1% interest penalty
suitabilityHorizon: 15+ years (The gold standard for conservative debt compounding)

name: National Pension System (NPS Tier I)
structure: Defined Contribution Pension Architecture managed by PFRDA-licensed PFMs
economicExposure: Blended Asset Classes: E (Equity), C (Corporate Debt), G (G-Secs), A (Alternative)
returnVariability: Moderate to High (Depends on Equity/Debt allocation)
creditRisk: Extremely Low for G & C sleeves
marketRisk: Moderate
liquidity: Extremely Low (Strict statutory lock-in until age 60)
fees: Ultra-low fund management fee: 0.09% per annum (Cheapest investment product in India)
taxOnIncome: No tax during accumulation phase
taxOnGains: At 60: 60% lump sum is 100% TAX-FREE; 40% annuity purchase is exempt at transfer, but monthly annuity pension is taxed at slab
tdsDetails: No TDS during accumulation or on 60% lump sum
regulatoryFramework: PFRDA Act, 2013 & NPS Trust
investorEligibility: All Indian Citizens aged 18 to 70
transparency: High (Daily NAV disclosures by SBI, HDFC, ICICI, UTI Pension Funds)
permanentLossRisk: Extremely Low over multi-decade career accumulation
exitRestrictions: Cannot exit before 60 without forcing 80% of corpus into annuity
suitabilityHorizon: Until Age 60 (Retirement corpus creation with extra ₹50k 80CCD(1B) tax deduction)

name: Direct US Equities & Global ETFs (via RBI LRS)
structure: Direct Foreign Equity Holding via US Brokerage Partner under RBI LRS
economicExposure: Global Innovation Leaders & US S&P 500 / Nasdaq 100
historicalNominalReturn: 13.5% – 16.5% in INR terms (10-12% USD CAGR + 3-4% USD/INR appreciation)
returnVariability: High (US market volatility + Currency exchange fluctuations)
creditRisk: None (Protected up to $500,000 by SIPC in US brokerage accounts)
marketRisk: High
liquidity: High (T+1 US settlement; 2-3 business days for bank telegraphic wire repatriation)
fees: FX remittance markup: 0.75%–1.5%; Brokerage: $0 to $1 per trade
taxOnIncome: US dividends incur 25% US Withholding Tax (Offset in India via Form 67 under Article 25 DTAA)
taxOnGains: LTCG: 12.5% if held > 24m (Finance Act 2024); STCG: Slab rate
tdsDetails: 20% LRS TCS collected upfront by Indian bank on remittances > ₹7 Lakhs per FY (Claimable as refund or advance tax adjustment in annual ITR)
regulatoryFramework: RBI Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) & US SEC/FINRA
investorEligibility: Indian Resident Individuals (LRS limit $250,000 per FY)
complexity: Moderate to High (Filing Foreign Assets Schedule FA in ITR is mandatory)
diversification: Essential geographic and currency hedge against domestic emerging market risk
permanentLossRisk: Low for S&P 500 index; High for speculative single-tech stocks
exitRestrictions: Sell anytime during US market hours; Funds repatriated to Indian bank account
operationalEffort: Moderate (ITR Schedule FA reporting and Form 67 tax credit filing)

name: Category II Alternative Investment Fund (Private Equity / Private Credit)
structure: Closed-Ended Trust / Company under SEBI AIF Regulations 2012
economicExposure: Unlisted Indian Middle-Market Enterprises & Structured Credit
returnVariability: High (J-curve effect: negative early returns followed by back-ended exits)
maxDrawdown: High potential for write-offs in individual portfolio companies
creditRisk: Moderate to High
marketRisk: High (Macroeconomic enterprise risk and delayed IPO exit markets)
liquidity: Zero (Strictly locked for 5 to 7+ years)
lockIn: 5 to 7 years with fund manager discretion for 1-2 year extensions
minInvestment: ₹1 Crore minimum ticket size per investor mandated by SEBI
fees: Management fee: 1.5%–2.0% annually; Performance carry: 20% over 8% hurdle rate
taxOnIncome: Pass-through tax status: Income taxed in investor hands as if directly earned
taxOnGains: LTCG: 12.5% on unlisted shares if held > 24m
tdsDetails: 10% TDS deducted by AIF on distributions under Section 194LBB
regulatoryFramework: SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012
investorEligibility: Accredited High Net Worth Individuals (HNIs), Family Offices
transparency: Moderate (Quarterly valuation reports by independent valuers)
diversification: Concentrated in 10 to 20 unlisted private companies
permanentLossRisk: High for individual startup equity; Moderate for senior secured private debt
exitRestrictions: Cannot liquidate early; Capital returned via fund distribution waterfall upon company exits
operationalEffort: Passive once committed (Capital drawn via capital calls)

name: Small Manufacturing / Agro-Processing Enterprise
structure: Direct Operating Private Limited Company or LLP
economicExposure: Indian Industrial / Food / Cattle Feed Production and B2B Distribution
returnVariability: Very High (Dependent on raw material volatility, energy costs & client orders)
maxDrawdown: Significant risk of operating cash burn during economic downturns
creditRisk: High on trade receivables (B2B credit terms 45 to 90 days)
marketRisk: High (Competitor price cutting, technological obsolescence)
liquidity: Illiquid (Capital tied up in plant, machinery, inventory & working capital)
fees: Auditor fees, compliance overhead, machinery depreciation, factory upkeep
taxOnIncome: Corporate Tax rate 22% (Sec 115BAA) + surcharge + 4% cess; GST compliance
taxOnGains: Dividends to owners taxed at individual slab rates
tdsDetails: Section 194C (contractors), 194J (professionals), 194Q (goods purchase)
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2013, MSME Development Act, Pollution Control Board, Factory Act
investorEligibility: Active Entrepreneurs, Operating Partners, Angel Investors
permanentLossRisk: High if unit economics fail or debt servicing collapses
exitRestrictions: Requires finding a strategic buyer or generational succession
suitabilityHorizon: 10+ to 25 years (Highest potential wealth creation engine in India)
